response.justification: Despite extensive experience as a senior software developer, the candidate lacks junior-level alignment: Java is only listed as a skill without project context in the insurance or agile context, German is only basic (not fluent as required), and the resume reflects senior/lead roles inconsistent with an entry-level position, raising concerns about overqualification and cultural fit.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong open-source contributions and technical workshops demonstrating knowledge sharing
Proven exposure to cloud (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes) and agile practices (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not fluent as required for client collaboration
Resume portrays senior-level experience, contradicting entry-level role expectations
No demonstrated experience in insurance domain or agile digitalization projects
